name: Yuutai☆Ridatsu!! Dokodemo Dare demo Yari Houdai!!
original_name: ゆ～たい☆りだつっ !! どこでも だれでも ヤりほうだい !!
source:
Toshio Aida, a young man with constant sexy daydreams, got in a traffic accident and from that out-of-body experience, he gained the power to project his spirit.
He could feel. He could cause feelings. Nobody saw his ethereal form, and no physical laws of the universe can stop him.

Toshio's brush with death was no big deal.
But to fulfill his daydreams... it's like paradise on earth!

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE165799.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
有着不断色情妄想的年轻人相田俊夫遭遇交通事故，并在灵魂出窍后获得投射灵魂的力量。

他能感受，也能让别人产生感觉。没人能看见他的灵体，宇宙的物理法则也无法阻止他。

俊夫与死亡擦肩而过并不是什么大事。

但要实现他的妄想……这简直是人间天堂！

[来源：[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE165799.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
